messages:
alex: Heads-up — customer acme-prod reporting repeated 429s and very slow tail latency on Dedicated pool eu-west-2 since ~08:03 UTC. They say traffic was steady, not huge.

alex: Quick triage: their app shows long request queueing, our metrics show target pods are Pending/NotReady for tens of seconds before serving.

emma-cs: Customer provided a few request ids and a short repro curl loop. They also attached a screenshot of 429 spikes at 08:05. Escalated to us. :grimacing:

priya: Looking at k8s events for the affected nodegroup: several pods stuck at 0/1 init containers — init named `model-sync`. Events show Pulling -> Started -> Pull complete -> Created -> Started but init container stays Running and pod not Ready. Not ImagePullBackOff.

jun: paste:```
kubectl describe pod model-abc-xyz
Events:
  Type     Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----     ------     ----  ----               -------
  Normal   Scheduled  2m    default-scheduler  Successfully assigned ...
  Normal   Pulling    2m    kubelet            Pulling image "registry.internal/redwood-models:onnx-big"
  Normal   Pulled     115s  kubelet            Successfully pulled image
  Normal   Created    115s  kubelet            Created container model-sync-init
  Normal   Started    114s  kubelet            Started container model-sync-init
  Warning  Unhealthy  40s   kubelet            Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 500
```

morgan: Interesting — init container runs a model-sync that downloads artifacts from S3 then extracts. If the init container is heavy it blocks main container from start, so pod can't serve until finished. That explains long NotReady and scale lag.

alex: Autoscaler logs during spike show it attempted to scale but hit per-cluster instance quota and then a cooldown was observed. Also saw message from the scaler: `scaleUp forbidden: recent scale activity` twice. So it's a mixed problem: slow pod readiness + cooldown/quota => delayed capacity.

priya: Repro steps I ran in staging to mimic issue: spike traffic -> controller requests X more replicas -> new pod scheduled -> init-container spends ~90s downloading 1.8GB model tar -> pod not Ready until after extract -> requests queue. Script:```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.test/generate &
done
```

jun: Also found kernel logs on one node showing temporary disk IO saturation during many concurrent extracts which slowed all init containers on that host. Could be noisy neighbor: several pods starting at once pulling big artifacts.

morgan: Two immediate mitigations we can try: 1) Increase warm pool minReplicas for that customer pool to keep pre-warmed pods with artifacts present. 2) Switch model-sync init to background fetch + readiness probe that passes earlier (serve with small model / cached lightweight mode) — needs code change.

emma-cs: Customer asked for ETA. Can we offer short-term workaround? They can route a small % of traffic to Hosted fallback to avoid 429s but prefer Dedicated.

alex: Short-term actions: @priya bump warm-pool minReplicas from 1->3 for acme-prod's pool (if infra OK). @jun file ticket to quota team to pre-approve temporary increase for instance spinups. @morgan create a postmortem-style issue capturing model-sync init as root cause and propose artifact prefetch job. I'll reply to customer with suggested fallback and timeline.

priya: On it — checking warm pool budget now. If we can increase minReplicas we can also prepopulate artifacts using a DaemonJob. Will ping infra if cloud quotas needed.

jun: Created internal ticket INF-4531 with excerpts of autoscaler logs and k8s describes, assigning to quotas team. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4531

morgan: For longer-term: we should add heuristics to autoscaler to account for init-container readiness delays (treat expected init time as part of scale target) and implement artifact cache warmers for model-heavy deployments. Also consider per-pool concurrency limits on rolling prefetches to avoid IO storms.

sre-bot: Incident bot: created incident INC-2024-229 and sent pager to on-call.

alex: I'll draft reply to customer with suggested temporary routing to hosted fallback + ask if they can accept brief maintenance window to bump warm pool. Will update thread after infra/quotas confirm. :thumbsup:
